slug: 2024-08-10 Angola - Dados Pessoais e Ciber-seguranca (APD enforcement)

facts.fact: PLMJ states that Angola's data protection framework has been in force since 2011, namely the Data Protection Law (Lei n.º 22/11, LPDP) of 17 June 2011; the date is the law's year as given, and the document is dated 2024-08-10.
PLMJ states that the Angolan Data Protection Agency (APD) was formally constituted in 2016.
PLMJ states that in June and July 2024 the APD published on its website sanctions against several companies in Angola for serious LPDP violations; it names no company and gives no count or amounts.
